system.description:
As a part of casting this jutsu, you must be in a forest, urban environment, or cavernous terrain.

You pull your weapons chain, wires or connective pieces, revealing that you already have a target surrounded by it, that you can see within range.

Select two creatures within range. Both must make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled, Restrained, unable to make hand seals (HS) and becoming Bruised on a failed save. They remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

Chain 2: You can select one creature to make this saving throw at disadvantage as all of your focus is on them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures affected by this jutsu by +1.
